posts.text: Haas has signed Rafael Câmara on a multi-year deal for 2027, replacing Esteban Ocon. The 21-year-old leads this year's Formula 2 standings with two rounds left. Oliver Bearman's 2027 seat is still to be confirmed. https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/13599318/rafael-camara-haas-sign-brazilian-ferrari-academy-driver-to-team-for-2027-formula-1-season-on-multi-year-deal
